pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Last Stand, growing with the tier, up to +9.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 5.

Will not count without:$(li)6 of Bone Block$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Bone Block$(li)any candles$(li)Soul Sand or Soul Soil$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#structural)any structural$(/l)$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#lighting)any lighting$(/l)$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Bones forms one cluster, and candles surrounds bones, and walls encloses the room.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Bones: Bone Block$(li)Candles: any candles$(li)Walls: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#structural)any structural$(/l)
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: And rooms that do not go with it - each one costs this room while it stands there:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/bedchamber)Bedchamber$(/l), sharing a wall
pages.title: Rooms that do not
